commits.message: security: hardening final and automated checks
Agregar reporte final y contenido de PR de migracion
Migracion completa a Azure + Copilot Security

semgrep.reason: Instalacion local incompleta en host Windows (resolucion de dependencias semgrep). Se habilito workflow CI security-semgrep.yml.

zap.reason: Docker/ZAP no disponible en host local. Se habilito workflow CI security-zap.yml.

iac_validate.reason: AADSTS530035 security defaults blocked management scope token.

function_publish.reason: func publish could not connect to Azure session in current host context.

publish.reason: Critical controls not all green (Semgrep/ZAP blocked), remote origin missing, gh unavailable, and Azure management-scope access blocked.

next_steps: Configure git remote origin and push branch security/hardening-final.
Install or authenticate gh CLI, then create repository secrets for Azure deployment.
Run workflows security-semgrep.yml and security-zap.yml in GitHub Actions.
Complete Azure login with management scope and rerun IaC validate/create and function publish.
Only publish after Semgrep and ZAP reports are passed and smoke test returns 200.
